faq_q1: How do I receive my tickets?
faq_a1: Tickets are sent to your email address as a PDF or mobile QR code immediately after payment. Keep them safe on your phone.
faq_a2: Absolutely. We are official partners of all major clubs in Ibiza, so you never run any risk at the door.
faq_q3: What time do I need to be inside?
faq_a3: Pay attention to the time slot on your ticket. Early-entry tickets often require you to be inside before a specific time (e.g., 01:00).
faq_q4: Can I also book VIP tables?
faq_a4: Yes, we offer VIP tables with bottles and personalized service for almost every club. Contact us via WhatsApp for prices.
